name: Marketing Tune-Up
tagline: Five-minute marketing fixes for small business owners, every Tuesday.
desc: Marketing Tune-Up is a quick weekly show for small business owners trying to navigate the complex world of marketing. Each episode, Dan and Kate take one topic, like your Google Business Profile, reviews, photos, AI search, social media or ads, and break it down in about five minutes. You get what the latest research says, what actually works, and one simple fix you can make this week. Every stat is real and credited, the advice is practical, and the hosts are delightfully, openly AI. New episodes every Tuesday from 6 String Creative.
